claims.statement: The constant-3 retained-U tree payment for arbitrary quadratic controls times an arbitrary disjoint retained Boolean core is correct for every finite adaptive/pruned physical control tree with pathwise nonreuse.
Branchwise reuse of a physical coordinate does not duplicate influence credit because its query-node reach cylinders are pairwise disjoint and flip-invariant.
No dimension-free adaptive payment is proved for nonflat shared-variable cores.
